QuestInfo.name: [Labyrinth of Suffering] Follow the Screams
QuestInfo.0: The agonized screaming is getting louder, but the source is still unknown. Who could it possibly be? It seems to be coming from the other side of the #rdoor to your right#k.
QuestInfo.1: Search for the source of the sound.
QuestInfo.2: When you finally reached the source of the screaming, you discovered an unconscious Alliance soldier tied to a thorn tree.
